en.headline: Games chief says Hong Kong sent about 90 fewer athletes
en.dek: Wong Po-kee told RTHK the internal target was only to match Hangzhou, and that the 54-medal haul finished one medal higher.
body: The Hong Kong delegation's chef de mission, Wong Po-kee, said on an RTHK programme on Monday that he had been surprised by 11 gold medals at the Nagoya Asian Games, singling out rowing, sailing and windsurfing.

Wong said the pre-Games internal estimate had been conservative because the team took about 90 fewer athletes than before. Matching the previous Games in Hangzhou would already have been satisfactory, he said. Hong Kong finished with 54 medals, one more than Hangzhou's 53, and with a record 11 golds. The tally of 11 gold, 19 silver and 24 bronze was the delegation's best by both golds and total medals.

He credited the government and the Hong Kong Sports Institute with more support for sports science, including tools that help athletes on the water read currents and wind, and equipment changes that improved positioning. He said he hoped that investment in sports technology would continue.

zh.headline: 黃寶基：今屆亞運少派約90名運動員
zh.dek: 代表團團長在港台表示，賽前內部目標只是追平杭州成績，最終54面獎牌比上屆多一面。
body: 中國香港代表團團長黃寶基星期一在港台節目表示，對名古屋亞運取得11面金牌感到喜出望外，並特別提到賽艇、帆船及滑浪風帆。
黃寶基說，賽前內部估算較保守，因為今屆少了約90名運動員。他說當時希望獎牌數目能與上屆杭州亞運相若已經滿意。港隊最終取得54面獎牌，比杭州的53面多一面；11金19銀24銅的金牌數目及總數均為歷屆最多。
他感謝政府及香港體育學院在運動科研上增加投放，舉例說海上項目可借助科技了解水紋及風向，並改善裝備，幫助運動員較早搶佔有利位置。他期望當局日後繼續在運動科技投放資源。
